mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are starting off with a dense drizzle and a temperature of 61 degrees around Verona Area High School, under a waning gibbous moon phase.

In city news, a section of Highway M near the future Aldi location will be closed from October 6th through October 9th for paving and shoulder work, with detours routed through Old PB and East Verona Avenue. Also, early voting times have been announced at City Hall starting Tuesday, October 20th, and the Plan Commission will review several development proposals, including a Sub-Zero site plan, on Monday, October 5th.

We have a wonderful lineup of events happening today, including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, tomorrow features Hop Haus Trivia in Verona, and this Friday you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard.

In the weekly police recap, officers responded to a vehicle versus bicycle crash on Thursday, September 24th, at Westward and Jenna Drive, where an eleven-year-old child collided with a car after failing to stop at a stop sign, but fortunately escaped serious injury.
If you are craving a sweet treat, Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM with today's flavor of the day, so plan a stop by before they close tonight at 10:00 PM.
